entry.title: fix(ui): restore browser journeys after the shared-primitive refactor
entry.content:
fix(ui): restore browser journeys after the shared-primitive refactor

The accent status pill missed text contrast on its soft ground, list rows named their link with
the whole row instead of the title, and the audio clear button lost its saved wording. Specs
that still addressed the old reading card markup now target the shared list row.

entry.title: refactor(ui): share card, notice, status and layout primitives
entry.content:
refactor(ui): share card, notice, status and layout primitives

Surfaces, feedback and layout now come from one file per primitive under
web/src/styles/components: card and inset, notice, status pill, facts, stack
and actions, segmented, group title. Every local .mn-error, .error, .mn-panel,
.mn-settings-section, tag, badge, pill-shaped .status and .actions copy now uses
them, and the uppercase labels are sentence-case group titles. _controls.scss
keeps only form fields, the switch and the disclosure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(reader): stop defining katakana names as hiragana words
entry.content:
fix(reader): stop defining katakana names as hiragana words

The bundled dictionary has no names, so a proper noun reached an unrelated entry through
reading or variant folding: the name アンナ showed the meaning of あんな. Proper nouns now
accept only their exact spelling and otherwise report no definition.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(vocabulary): recognize entries split only when analyzed alone
entry.content:
fix(vocabulary): recognize entries split only when analyzed alone

IPADIC reads 十分 alone as 十 + 分 but as one token in これで十分です. Such
entries were indexed only as phrases, so the single token never matched. The
whole expression is now also an exact and normalized single-token key; joined
per-token readings stay excluded because they can name another word.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(reader): keep policy exceptions unmarked in generated stories
entry.content:
fix(reader): keep policy exceptions unmarked in generated stories

The reader classified every reading against the current snapshot only, so a word the exception
review approved - by definition not in Anki - came back as not-in-snapshot and was underlined. A
generated story now falls back to its frozen validation for any token the snapshot does not cover,
as the glossary's definition of Known already said. A word learned since still stops being marked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(generation): let the story writer draw on the exception policy
entry.content:
fix(generation): let the story writer draw on the exception policy

The policy only reached the post-hoc exception review, while the writing and repair prompts told
the model the inventory was the complete vocabulary, so allowed loanwords and names never appeared.
Writing, blueprint, segment and repair prompts now carry the policy; the review still decides.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: feat(generation): focus recently learned stories on the newest words
entry.content:
feat(generation): focus recently learned stories on the newest words

Recently learned now sends the N most recently first-reviewed words (25, 50 or 100, default 50)
as an ordered focus list with coarse ages, instead of weighting the palette by a 120-day
half-life. The palette is drawn uniformly from the remaining words, and provenance records the
focus and its size. Story and repair prompts move to version 4. See ADR 0067.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: feat(anki): recover FSRS difficulty from desktop AnkiConnect
entry.content:
feat(anki): recover FSRS difficulty from desktop AnkiConnect

AnkiConnect's cardsInfo carries no FSRS memory state, so desktop vocabulary never had a
difficulty. The desktop adapter now resolves it to the whole percent with a parallel binary
search over Anki's `prop:d` search on the existing read-only findCards action. SM-2 cards stay
without difficulty, and a refused search leaves it unsupported without failing the refresh.

The per-card `cid:` query packing is shared with the AnkiDroid `introduced:` search, and the
fake AnkiConnect server can now answer with the desktop add-on's real cardsInfo shape.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(anki): read learning state from desktop AnkiConnect cards
entry.content:
fix(anki): read learning state from desktop AnkiConnect cards

AnkiConnect's cardsInfo names the card type `type`, while the schema only read the bridge's
`cardType`, so desktop refreshes silently lost learning state. Both keys now fold into
`cardType` at the schema boundary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
